entries.description: Songs replay without using data, the player follows your finger, and new versions show up in About again

changelog.title: New
items: Songs you stream are kept on your phone, so playing them again uses no data. Choose how much space in Settings, Playback
If your connection drops in the middle of a song, it carries on from the same moment instead of skipping ahead

changelog.title: Improved
items: The player follows your finger up and down, at any speed, and closes onto one mini player
Stream has your picture at the top left, with Devices and the LuvLyrics logo together at the top right
Songs and Playlists in Stream switch with one neat control
The app finds new versions reliably, so updates show up in About

entries.description: Search can retry when the catalog cannot be reached, and small buttons are easier to tap

changelog.title: Improved
items: Search tells you when the catalog cannot be reached, with a Try again button
The close button on the info card works
Small buttons are easier to tap, including the info buttons and filter chips
Text in Search and the Now Playing controls no longer gets cut off at larger sizes

entries.description: You can copy your listening history to your own ListenBrainz profile

changelog.title: New
items: Connect ListenBrainz in Settings to keep a copy of what you listen to on your own profile
Your full history stays on this phone, and nothing is sent until you connect

entries.description: Closing the player and reading messages is smoother and clearer

changelog.title: Improved
items: Closing the player now lands on one full-width mini-player
Error messages are written in plain words and counts read correctly, such as 1 song
Library tabs stay steady when you switch between them
The lyrics editor asks before you drop unsaved changes
